record.bible_text: But king<WH04428> Solomon<WH08010> loved<WH0157><WTH8804> many<WH07227> strange<WH05237> women<WH0802>, together with the daughter<WH01323> of Pharaoh<WH06547>, women of the Moabites<WH04125>, Ammonites<WH05984>, Edomites<WH0130>, Zidonians<WH06722>, <FI>and<Fi> Hittites<WH02850>; <RF>together...: or, beside<Rf>
